recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If a current manifest-like collection needs new guidance, raise or use a current-release tracker against List or another active resource instead of reviving the retired DocumentManifest narrative.
issue_request: FHIR-13534 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 change request for DocumentManifest. It observed that the introduction and scope described collections of DocumentReference resources even though DocumentManifest.content allowed a broader payload, and the final decision was to broaden the introduction to a manifest of any FHIR resource types while still noting DocumentReference as a prime use.
initial_application: Git commit 94e532a611046fcdc40df2d7d28457eeb7dad3a6 appears to apply the issue. Its message names the San Diego WGM DocumentManifest block vote and includes GF#13534, and its patch changes source/documentmanifest/documentmanifest-introduction.xml from "a set of DocumentReference resources" to "a set of Resources," adds that DocumentManifest's use of "document" is broader than formal FHIR documents or DocumentReference resources, and states that DocumentManifest can bring clinical context grouping to a broader set of Resources.
additional_context: The same 2017 block-vote commit also applied FHIR-12655 by removing the attachment-specific content model and simplifying DocumentManifest around resource references. Later Published issue FHIR-33021 warned that DocumentManifest might be retired because IHE MHD had moved to List. Current source/fhir.ini has no active documentmanifest resource entry, comments the old workgroup/TLA/status entries, marks DocumentManifest as dropped, and maps the old type to List; source/history.html records DocumentManifest as removed with "use List." Git commit ea941737076615e7e2772299c80c63e1490f2e93 deleted the DocumentManifest source files, and FHIR-39006 moved XDS-related examples and mappings to List.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The requested broadening was applied to the historical DocumentManifest introduction, and the current build no longer has an authoritative DocumentManifest resource page, StructureDefinition, or content element to amend. Reintroducing or further editing DocumentManifest prose in current core would contradict the later retirement path rather than reconcile FHIR-13534.

related_jiras.note: Same 2017 DocumentManifest block vote removed pAttachment and helped establish the broader resource-reference model that FHIR-13534's narrative described.
Published R5 decision to warn that DocumentManifest would be retired unless use cases appeared, because IHE MHD had moved to List.
Published List issue that moved XDS mappings and examples from the retiring DocumentManifest usage into List.
Earlier attachment-content issue later superseded by FHIR-12655 and already audited on the combined branch; it explains why DocumentManifest.content history cannot be read in isolation.

evidence_items.learned: Related content-model history supports interpreting FHIR-13534 as broad resource-reference narrative, not a need to restore inline attachments.
